title: WPMS/407/2007 of SMT. MANJULIKA SHARMA Vs THE CIVIL JUDGE AND ANR.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND ATNAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 407 of 2007 (M/S)
Smt. Manjulika Sharma W/O Sri Satyendar Kumar, R/O Village
Raipur, Near Shiv Mandir, Dehradun through her duly appointed
attorney Sri Satyendar Kumar S/O Late Shri Kabool Chand R/O
Village Raipur, Near Shiv Mandir, Dehradun, vide attorney deed
dated 06-10-2003..
 ......... Petitioner.
 Versus
1. Civil Judge (Junior Division) Dehradun.
3. Shri Brij Mohan Unniyal, S/O not known Resident of Raipur
Ranjhawala via Dhang, Near Primary School, Dehradun.
 .....Respondents.
Sri Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Sri Gopal Narain Srivastava, Brief Holder of the State, learned counsel for the
respondent No.1-State.
Dated May 11, 2007.
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
The only prayer made in this writ petition is that the
Civil Judge (Junior Division) Dehradun be directed to decide the
Original Suit No. 259 of 2003, Smt. Manjulika Sharma Vs. Shri
Brij Mohan Unniyal expeditiously, with the allegation that the
petitioner-plaintiff filed the suit for a decree of permanent
injunction against the respondent no.2 in the year 2003 claiming
himself Bhumidhar of land of Khasra No. 600 area 0.10 acre
situated in village Raipur, Pargana Parwadoon, District Dehradun,
which was purchased by him through registered sale deed dated 3-
5-1985. It is alleged that the defendant-respondent with an
intention to grab the land of the plaintiff opened a gate towards the
land of the plaintiff thereby encroached the land of the petitioner.
The defendant-respondent filed his written statement as far back as
16-4-2004, but thereafter, the defendant has been seeking frequent
adjournments to prolong the litigation. It has been alleged that the
trial court vide order dated 27-4-2004 ordered that the application

for temporary injunction (6-C) shall be decided at the time of final
hearing of the suit, therefore, the defendant is no interested in
speedy decision of the suit.
The suit filed by the petitioner against the respondent
no.2 is pending before the trial court since the year 2003, therefore,
in the facts and circumstances of the case, the ends of justice will
be subserved if the trial court is directed to decide the suit pending
between the parties on merits, expeditiously, as far as possible.
The Civil Judge (Junior Division) Dehradun is directed
to decide the Original Suit No. 259 of 2003, Smt. Manjulika
Sharma Vs. Shri Brij Mohan Uniyal on merits pending in that court
expeditiously as far as possible.
With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed
of finally.

All applications stand disposed of.
 (B.S.Verma, J.)
RCP
